natural: I go on doing things my usual way

meaning.en: To go one's own way regardless of what others say.
meaning.zh: 不管别人怎么说，仍按自己平常的一套去做。

equivalents: march to the beat of one's own drum

examples.zh: 家里人都劝他换个工作，他却我行我素。
examples.en: His family all urged him to change jobs, but he just went his own way.

examples.zh: 老师批评了好几次，他还是我行我素，上课玩手机。
examples.en: The teacher told him off several times, but he carried on playing with his phone in class regardless.

usage.en: Predicate. Often mildly critical (ignoring advice), but can admire independence.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。多含不听劝告的贬义，有时也指有主见。

natural: Thinking deeply and considering thoroughly

meaning.en: After careful and thorough consideration.
meaning.zh: 深入细致地反复思考。

examples.zh: 经过深思熟虑，她决定出国读研。
examples.en: After careful thought, she decided to do her master's abroad.

examples.zh: 这么重要的决定，必须深思熟虑。
examples.en: A decision this important needs careful consideration.

usage.en: Often 经过深思熟虑 (after careful thought) or as predicate/attributive.
usage.zh: 常用"经过深思熟虑"，也作谓语、定语。

natural: No detail too small to reach

meaning.en: Attentive in every detail; looking after someone with the utmost care.
meaning.zh: 没有一处细微的地方不照顾到。形容关怀、照顾得非常细心周到。

equivalents: wait on someone hand and foot
look after someone like a baby

examples.zh: 住院期间，护士们对他照顾得无微不至。
examples.en: While he was in hospital, the nurses attended to his every need.

examples.zh: 妈妈对我的关心无微不至。
examples.en: My mother looks after me with the greatest care.

usage.en: Mostly predicate or complement of 关怀/照顾 (照顾得无微不至).
usage.zh: 多作"关怀、照顾"的谓语或补语，如"照顾得无微不至"。

natural: Carts like flowing water, horses like a dragon

meaning.en: Heavy traffic; a busy, bustling street.
meaning.zh: 车像流水，马像游龙。形容来往车马很多，连续不断的热闹情景。

examples.zh: 市中心的大街上车水马龙，十分热闹。
examples.en: The streets downtown are bustling with traffic.

examples.zh: 这里十年前还是农田，现在已经车水马龙了。
examples.en: Ten years ago this was farmland; now it's full of traffic.

story.en: Empress Ma refused favours for her relatives, recalling the crowds at their gates: "carriages like flowing water, horses like a swimming dragon" (车如流水，马如游龙).
story.zh: 马皇后说："前过濯龙门上，见外家问起居者，车如流水，马如游龙。"

usage.en: Predicate. Describes busy streets and prosperous places.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，形容街道繁华热闹。

natural: Showing one's head and horns

meaning.en: To begin to show one's talent; to make one's mark for the first time.
meaning.zh: 比喻初次显露出才能和本领（多指青少年）。

examples.zh: 她十六岁就在全国比赛中崭露头角。
examples.en: She made her mark at a national competition at just sixteen.

examples.zh: 这位年轻导演凭第一部电影崭露头角。
examples.en: The young director first showed his talent with his debut film.

story.en: Han Yu's epitaph for his friend Liu Zongyuan says that even as a youth Liu "prominently showed his head and horns" (崭然见头角), standing out from everyone.
story.zh: 韩愈《柳子厚墓志铭》说柳宗元少年时"虽少年，已自成人，能取进士第，崭然见头角"。

usage.en: Predicate. Usually about young people or newcomers. 崭 is zhǎn; 露 is lù here (not lòu).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指青少年或新人。"露"读 lù。

natural: Having the numbers in one's head

meaning.en: To know what one is doing; to have a clear idea of the situation.
meaning.zh: 对情况和问题有基本的了解，处理事情有一定把握。

examples.zh: 别担心，这件事怎么办，我心中有数。
examples.en: Don't worry — I know exactly how to handle this.

examples.zh: 考前做几套模拟题，自己就心中有数了。
examples.en: Do a few practice papers before the exam and you'll know where you stand.

usage.en: Predicate. Colloquial and common. Opposite: 心中无数 / 心里没底.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语常用。反义可说"心中无数""心里没底"。

natural: Open in four directions, reaching all eight

meaning.en: Well connected in every direction; with transport links everywhere.
meaning.zh: 四面八方都有路可通，形容交通极其便利。

examples.zh: 这座城市地铁四通八达，出行很方便。
examples.en: The city's metro reaches everywhere, so getting around is easy.

examples.zh: 村里修了四通八达的公路，农产品更好卖了。
examples.en: With roads connecting the village in every direction, farm produce is easier to sell.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Mostly about roads, transport and networks.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多形容交通、网络。

natural: Spring is warm and the flowers are blooming

meaning.en: Warm spring days with flowers in bloom; also a good time or a favourable situation.
meaning.zh: 春天气候温暖，百花盛开，景色优美。也比喻大好时机。

examples.zh: 春暖花开的时候，我们去郊外踏青吧。
examples.en: When spring comes and the flowers bloom, let's go for a walk in the countryside.

examples.zh: 等到春暖花开，疫情过去，再来看你。
examples.en: I'll come and see you when the weather warms up and the pandemic is over.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (春暖花开的季节). Common in writing about spring and in greetings.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。常用于写春天和祝福语。

natural: The law of heaven and the justice of earth

meaning.en: Perfectly right and natural; something that goes without saying.
meaning.zh: 天地间理所当然、不可改变的道理。指理所当然的事。

examples.zh: 欠债还钱，天经地义。
examples.en: Paying back what you owe goes without saying.

examples.zh: 父母照顾孩子是天经地义的事。
examples.en: It's only natural for parents to look after their children.

story.en: Zichan of Zheng is quoted: "Ritual is the warp of heaven, the righteousness of earth, and the conduct of the people" (夫礼，天之经也，地之义也，民之行也).
story.zh: 《左传》："夫礼，天之经也，地之义也，民之行也。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (天经地义的事). Can be used critically about things wrongly taken for granted.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。也可用来批评把某事看作理所当然。

natural: When the water falls, the rocks appear

meaning.en: The truth comes out; everything becomes clear.
meaning.zh: 水落下去，石头就露出来。比喻事情的真相完全显露出来。

equivalents: get to the bottom of it

examples.zh: 警方一定会把这件事查个水落石出。
examples.en: The police will certainly get to the bottom of this.

examples.zh: 真相总有水落石出的一天。
examples.en: The truth will come out one day.

story.en: Su Shi's Second Ode on the Red Cliff describes winter on the Yangtze: "The mountains are high and the moon small; the water has fallen and the rocks emerge" (山高月小，水落石出).
story.zh: 苏轼《后赤壁赋》："山高月小，水落石出。"原写冬季江景。

usage.en: Often 查个水落石出 (investigate until the truth is out). Originally a scenic description.
usage.zh: 常用"查个水落石出"。原为写景。

natural: Singing and dancing

meaning.en: Singing and dancing joyfully; celebrating.
meaning.zh: 又唱歌，又跳舞。形容尽情欢乐。

examples.zh: 节日里，村民们载歌载舞，庆祝丰收。
examples.en: At the festival, the villagers sang and danced to celebrate the harvest.

examples.zh: 晚会上，各族群众载歌载舞。
examples.en: At the gala, people of all ethnic groups sang and danced together.

usage.en: Predicate. Common in news about festivals. 载…载… = both…and…; 载 is zài.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于节日报道。"载"读 zài，意为"又"。

natural: Drifting about, having lost one's home

meaning.en: Homeless and displaced; forced to wander with nowhere to live.
meaning.zh: 转徙离散，没有安身的地方。

equivalents: without a roof over one's head

examples.zh: 战争让成千上万的人流离失所。
examples.en: The war has left tens of thousands of people displaced.

examples.zh: 洪水过后，许多灾民流离失所。
examples.en: After the flood, many victims were left homeless.

usage.en: Predicate, often 使/让……流离失所. Common in news about war and disasters.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"使/让……流离失所"，多见于战争、灾害报道。

natural: Save the dying and help the wounded

meaning.en: To save lives and heal the injured; the duty of doctors and nurses.
meaning.zh: 抢救生命垂危的人，照顾受伤的人。现多指医务工作者的职责。

examples.zh: 救死扶伤是医生的天职。
examples.en: Saving lives is a doctor's sacred duty.

examples.zh: 地震发生后，医疗队日夜救死扶伤。
examples.en: After the earthquake, the medical teams worked day and night saving lives.

story.en: Sima Qian describes Li Ling's outnumbered army, so hard-pressed that its men "had no time even to save the dying and support the wounded" (救死扶伤不给).
story.zh: 司马迁《报任安书》写李陵兵败："救死扶伤不给。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Today almost always about medical work.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，现多用于医务工作。

natural: Roaming free outside the law

meaning.en: To go unpunished; a criminal remaining at large.
meaning.zh: 犯法的人没有受到法律制裁，仍然自由自在。

examples.zh: 绝不能让犯罪分子逍遥法外。
examples.en: We must never let criminals escape justice.

examples.zh: 凶手逍遥法外多年，终于落网。
examples.en: The killer was at large for years before finally being caught.

usage.en: Predicate. Common in news and legal language; often 不能让……逍遥法外.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，新闻、法律中常用，如"不能让……逍遥法外"。

natural: Shed the mortal womb and change one's bones

meaning.en: To be completely transformed; to become a new person.
meaning.zh: 原为道教用语，指修道成仙。现比喻彻底改变立场、观点或面貌。

examples.zh: 经过一年的训练，这支球队脱胎换骨了。
examples.en: After a year of training, the team was completely transformed.

examples.zh: 老城区改造后脱胎换骨，焕然一新。
examples.en: After redevelopment, the old district was transformed beyond recognition.

usage.en: Predicate. Originally Daoist (becoming an immortal); now any thorough change for the better.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。原为道教语，现指彻底的好的变化。

natural: Raging wind and torrential rain

meaning.en: A violent storm; also a dangerous, turbulent situation.
meaning.zh: 猛烈的风和急骤的雨。也比喻猛烈的声势或险恶的处境。

examples.zh: 昨晚狂风暴雨，路边的树倒了好几棵。
examples.en: There was a violent storm last night and several roadside trees came down.

examples.zh: 公司经历了市场的狂风暴雨，终于站稳了脚跟。
examples.en: The company weathered the storms of the market and finally found its feet.

usage.en: Subject, object or predicate. Literal or figurative.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语、谓语，可实指也可比喻。

natural: Clear mountains and lovely waters

meaning.en: Beautiful scenery of hills and rivers.
meaning.zh: 山水秀丽，形容风景优美。

examples.zh: 桂林山清水秀，每年吸引大量游客。
examples.en: Guilin's beautiful hills and rivers draw huge numbers of tourists every year.

examples.zh: 他退休后搬到一个山清水秀的小镇住。
examples.en: After retiring he moved to a picturesque little town.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Also 山明水秀.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。也作"山明水秀"。

natural: Getting just what one wished for

meaning.en: To have one's wish fulfilled; to get what one wanted.
meaning.zh: 按所希望的那样得到满足，指愿望实现。

examples.zh: 努力了三年，他终于如愿以偿考上了北大。
examples.en: After three years of hard work, he finally got his wish and got into Peking University.

examples.zh: 球队如愿以偿地拿到了冠军。
examples.en: The team achieved what they'd hoped for and won the championship.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Often with 终于 (finally).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，常与"终于"连用。

natural: Take others' strengths to make up for one's weaknesses

meaning.en: To learn from others' strengths to make up for one's own weaknesses.
meaning.zh: 吸取别人的长处，来弥补自己的短处。

examples.zh: 同学之间要互相学习，取长补短。
examples.en: Classmates should learn from each other and make up for each other's weaknesses.

examples.zh: 两家公司合作，可以取长补短。
examples.en: By working together, the two companies can complement each other.

usage.en: Predicate. Common in school, teamwork and cooperation contexts; often with 互相.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"互相"连用，用于学习、合作。

natural: Making something out of nothing

meaning.en: To fabricate; to make up something that never happened.
meaning.zh: 把没有的说成有的。指凭空捏造。

examples.zh: 这些指控完全是无中生有。
examples.en: These accusations are complete fabrications.

examples.zh: 有人在网上无中生有，造谣说这家店用过期食材。
examples.en: Someone made up a rumour online that the restaurant uses expired ingredients.

story.en: Laozi says "all things under heaven are born of being, and being is born of non-being" (有生于无). The phrase later became one of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: creating an illusion to deceive the enemy.
story.zh: 《老子》："天下万物生于有，有生于无。"后为《三十六计》之一，指制造假象迷惑敌人。

usage.en: Predicate. Today almost always means fabricating rumours or accusations.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，现多指凭空捏造谣言、罪名。

natural: Stopping with a sudden clang

meaning.en: To stop abruptly (of a sound, story or activity).
meaning.zh: 形容声音突然停止，也指事情突然中止。

examples.zh: 音乐戛然而止，全场一片安静。
examples.en: The music stopped dead and the whole room fell silent.

examples.zh: 小说在高潮处戛然而止，让读者回味无穷。
examples.en: The novel breaks off abruptly at its climax, leaving readers to ponder.

usage.en: Predicate. 戛 is jiá (not gā). For sounds, stories, careers and trends.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"戛"读 jiá。可用于声音、故事、事业等。

natural: Skimping on labour and materials

meaning.en: To cut corners; to skimp on work and materials to save money.
meaning.zh: 不按要求施工或制作，暗中减少工序和用料。也指做事马虎。

examples.zh: 这座桥塌了，原来是施工方偷工减料。
examples.en: The bridge collapsed — it turned out the builders had cut corners.

examples.zh: 做作业不能偷工减料，每道题都要认真写。
examples.en: Don't cut corners on homework — answer every question properly.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Mainly construction and manufacturing; also any half-hearted work.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多用于工程、生产，也指做事马虎。

natural: Savouring the flavour

meaning.en: With great relish; eating or doing something with obvious enjoyment.
meaning.zh: 形容吃得很有味道，或对某事很有兴趣。

examples.zh: 孩子们吃得津津有味。
examples.en: The children tucked in with relish.

examples.zh: 爷爷津津有味地讲着他年轻时的故事。
examples.en: Grandpa told stories of his youth with great enjoyment.

usage.en: Usually complement (吃得津津有味) or adverbial (津津有味地看). Very common in school writing.
usage.zh: 多作补语、状语，如"吃得津津有味""津津有味地看"。作文常用。

natural: Largely the same, slightly different

meaning.en: Much the same, with only minor differences.
meaning.zh: 大部分相同，只有小部分不同。

equivalents: six of one, half a dozen of the other

examples.zh: 这几家店的价格大同小异。
examples.en: Prices at these shops are much of a muchness.

examples.zh: 两个方案大同小异，选哪个都行。
examples.en: The two plans are pretty much the same — either will do.

story.en: Zhuangzi cites the logician Hui Shi: "Large similarity differs from small similarity — this is called 'small sameness and difference'" (大同而与小同异，此之谓小同异).
story.zh: 《庄子·天下》引惠施语："大同而与小同异，此之谓小同异。"

usage.en: Predicate. Neutral, slightly dismissive (nothing special to choose between).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，略带"没什么区别"之意。

natural: Rub your eyes and look again

meaning.en: To see someone in a new light after they have greatly improved.
meaning.zh: 擦亮眼睛看。指用新的眼光来看待。

equivalents: see someone in a new light

examples.zh: 他这次考了第一，老师对他刮目相看。
examples.en: He came top this time, and the teacher sees him in a whole new light.

examples.zh: 这家小公司的新产品让业界刮目相看。
examples.en: The small company's new product made the industry sit up and take notice.

origin.source: 《三国志·吴书·吕蒙传》裴松之注引《江表传》

story.en: The general Lü Meng was thought uneducated until he took up study. When Lu Su was amazed by his learning, Lü said: "A scholar apart for three days must be looked at with rubbed eyes" (士别三日，即更刮目相待).
story.zh: 吕蒙听从孙权劝告读书，鲁肃惊叹其进步，吕蒙说："士别三日，即更刮目相待。"

usage.en: Often 让人/对……刮目相看. About someone or something exceeding expectations. Also written 刮目相待.
usage.zh: 常用"让人刮目相看""对……刮目相看"。也作“刮目相待”。
